summary: Iteration 17 verified the NEW Broadcast History feature end-to-end. Backend GET /api/admin/broadcast/history: 4/4 pytest tests pass (401 without token, 401 with bad token, correct payload shape/no _id/80-char preview cap/limit<=20/newest-first sort, and a synthetic newest-job injection proving ordering + error_counts + completed_at pass-through). Frontend: unlock via lock-chip + PIN 246810 works, broadcast-history-toggle expands broadcast-history-list with 17 rows (matches 17 docs in bot_broadcasts), row click expands to show 'failure breakdown (1 chat not found) completed <ts>' and collapses again, second toggle click unmounts the list. Verified on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Regressions verified: welcome payload save (welcome-ta/en + config-save -> 'saved - live on the bot', values persisted after reload and restored), change PIN (change-pin-input/change-pin-save -> 'PIN updated', PIN 246810 still valid afterwards via API + UI), unlock/lock chip flow (locking hides the whole broadcast/history block). Live broadcast send was intentionally NOT executed (would DM ~55 real Telegram users; test_credentials.md forbids DMing real users) - only the send button enable/disable + attach button states were verified.

ui_bugs.issue: Literal escape sequence rendered instead of a middot separator. /app/frontend/src/ConfigPanel.js line 416 has ' \u00b7 ' as bare JSX *text* (JSX text children do not process backslash escapes), so every row shows 'DONE \U00B7 0/1' (uppercased by the tracking/uppercase class) instead of 'DONE · 0/1'. Note line 417 is inside a template literal and renders correctly, which is why the same row shows both a broken and a correct separator. Fix: use {" \u00b7 "} or a real · character.
ui_bugs.priority: HIGH (cosmetic but on every history row, clearly visible)

issues: Row header is a single non-wrapping flex row: the status span ('DONE · 0/42 · 42 FAILED') consumes most of the width and the message preview collapses to ~8 chars ('object s…'/'objec…'), making rows unidentifiable on mobile. Consider flex-col / status on its own line below the preview under sm.

critical_code_review_comments: ConfigPanel.js:416 - escape sequences in bare JSX text are not interpreted; must be wrapped in a JS expression/template literal.

broadcast_history() indexes job['status'], job['sent'], job['failed'], job['total'] with hard keys - a legacy/partial broadcast doc missing any of these would 500 the whole endpoint. Prefer job.get(k, 0/'unknown').

db.bot_broadcasts.find({}).sort('created_at', -1) relies on created_at being an ISO *string* for all docs (verified: all 17 are str). If any writer ever stores a datetime, BSON mixed-type ordering will silently mis-sort. Consider a created_at index and a single storage type.
loadHistory() swallows the error into setHistory([]), so an API failure is indistinguishable from 'no broadcasts sent yet.' - surface an error state instead.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the visible '\U00B7' text: in JSX, string escape sequences are only processed inside JS expressions/string literals. ConfigPanel.js:416 places ' \u00b7 ' directly as element text between two {} expressions, so React renders the 8 literal characters; the parent's uppercase/tracking classes then display it as '\U00B7'. One-line fix.
